meta.title: Clash of Revelation - 1
meta.description: This body shall be kindling so that your hopes may be forged.

units.rawText: Arrows of starlight fall like rain, and Eosphorus does not stop his attack until Malkira's clone and Ptolemaea are blown to smithereens.
units.displayText: Arrows of starlight fall like rain, and Eosphorus does not stop his attack until Malkira's clone and Ptolemaea are blown to smithereens.

spans.text: Arrows of starlight fall like rain, and Eosphorus does not stop his attack until Malkira's clone and Ptolemaea are blown to smithereens.

units.rawText: Yet, the erupting operands do not calm down for a long time.
units.displayText: Yet, the erupting operands do not calm down for a long time.

spans.text: Yet, the erupting operands do not calm down for a long time.

units.rawText: Malkira's clone completely evaporates, but Eosphorus knows that he has merely destroyed a fraction of Malkira's true strength.
units.displayText: Malkira's clone completely evaporates, but Eosphorus knows that he has merely destroyed a fraction of Malkira's true strength.

spans.text: Malkira's clone completely evaporates, but Eosphorus knows that he has merely destroyed a fraction of Malkira's true strength.

units.rawText: I WILL find you, Malkira... and I will slay you upon your throne.
units.displayText: I WILL find you, Malkira... and I will slay you upon your throne.

spans.text: I WILL find you, Malkira... and I will slay you upon your throne.

units.rawText: Activating [objectTower_b3], initiating Sanctifier_Eliminate protocol. Please enter command.
units.displayText: Activating [objectTower_b3], initiating Sanctifier_Eliminate protocol. Please enter command.

spans.text: Activating [objectTower_b3], initiating Sanctifier_Eliminate protocol. Please enter command.

units.rawText: Eosphorus knows the system structure and quickly scrolls across the control interface until he reaches a key item.
units.displayText: Eosphorus knows the system structure and quickly scrolls across the control interface until he reaches a key item.

spans.text: Eosphorus knows the system structure and quickly scrolls across the control interface until he reaches a key item.

units.rawText: [objectTower_b3] Activate Halo Device.
units.displayText: [objectTower_b3] Activate Halo Device.

spans.text: [objectTower_b3] Activate Halo Device.

units.rawText: The Halo activation option...
units.displayText: The Halo activation option...

spans.text: The Halo activation option...

units.rawText: Eosphorus' hand pauses over the button, but then he clenches his fist.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' hand pauses over the button, but then he clenches his fist.

spans.text: Eosphorus' hand pauses over the button, but then he clenches his fist.

units.rawText: The Halo... What a lovely name. Last time, you lost half your operands. I wonder... What kind of price will you have to pay once you activate the Halo?
units.displayText: The Halo... What a lovely name. Last time, you lost half your operands. I wonder... What kind of price will you have to pay once you activate the Halo?

spans.text: The Halo... What a lovely name. Last time, you lost half your operands. I wonder... What kind of price will you have to pay once you activate the Halo?

units.rawText: What exactly happened to the first Sanctifiers that made them unable to conquer the Tartarus Sector?
units.displayText: What exactly happened to the first Sanctifiers that made them unable to conquer the Tartarus Sector?

spans.text: What exactly happened to the first Sanctifiers that made them unable to conquer the Tartarus Sector?

units.rawText: If the "first generation" had the technology to build "Watchtowers", then why could they not reach me?
units.displayText: If the "first generation" had the technology to build "Watchtowers", then why could they not reach me?

spans.text: If the "first generation" had the technology to build "Watchtowers", then why could they not reach me?

units.rawText: The time... has come...
units.displayText: The time... has come...

spans.text: The time... has come...

units.rawText: Eosphorus looks outside the Watchtower. The other two Halos have joined up, illuminating half of the Middle Ring.
units.displayText: Eosphorus looks outside the Watchtower. The other two Halos have joined up, illuminating half of the Middle Ring.

spans.text: Eosphorus looks outside the Watchtower. The other two Halos have joined up, illuminating half of the Middle Ring.

units.rawText: ...The die is cast. There is no turning back.
units.displayText: ...The die is cast. There is no turning back.

spans.text: ...The die is cast. There is no turning back.

units.rawText: Eosphorus looks toward the control terminal again. This time, he does not hesitate and presses the activation button.
units.displayText: Eosphorus looks toward the control terminal again. This time, he does not hesitate and presses the activation button.

spans.text: Eosphorus looks toward the control terminal again. This time, he does not hesitate and presses the activation button.

units.rawText: There is a familiar rumbling, and then the sacred purity of the Halo swiftly expands from the Watchtower.
units.displayText: There is a familiar rumbling, and then the sacred purity of the Halo swiftly expands from the Watchtower.

spans.text: There is a familiar rumbling, and then the sacred purity of the Halo swiftly expands from the Watchtower.

units.rawText: Eosphorus looks at the inauspicious maze. Its twisted lumps of meat seem to shift into Malkira's face, asking Eosphorus that vital question.
units.displayText: Eosphorus looks at the inauspicious maze. Its twisted lumps of meat seem to shift into Malkira's face, asking Eosphorus that vital question.

spans.text: Eosphorus looks at the inauspicious maze. Its twisted lumps of meat seem to shift into Malkira's face, asking Eosphorus that vital question.

units.rawText: Are you prepared to pay the price this time?
units.displayText: Are you prepared to pay the price this time?

spans.text: Are you prepared to pay the price this time?

units.rawText: If I can accomplish our wish and fulfill our mission...
units.displayText: If I can accomplish our wish and fulfill our mission...

spans.text: If I can accomplish our wish and fulfill our mission...

units.rawText: Purifying light engulfs the entire Labyrinth as the last Halo activates.
units.displayText: Purifying light engulfs the entire Labyrinth as the last Halo activates.

spans.text: Purifying light engulfs the entire Labyrinth as the last Halo activates.
